name: Capacete
known: Conceived by the artist Helmut Batista in 1997 (CAPACETE history page), who is listed as its overall director.
Rubens Takamine is artistic director.

name: Casa França-Brasil
known: It took the name Casa Brasil in 2025 after a curatorial repositioning (stated by the space).
Exhibitions, an artist residency and education courses for artists, curators and cultural mediators.
Director Tania Queiroz and general coordinator Jocelino Pessoa (stated by the space).

name: Instituto Tunga
known: Antônio Mourão, the artist's only son, is its director, and Clara Gerchman is co-founder and manager of the institute's collection (Arte!Brasileiros, Eduardo Simões, 13 January 2023;

name: Museu de Arte Moderna do Rio de Janeiro
known: It pays for school programmes, free transport for school groups, a young-artists space, the Super Sábados activities (over 21,000 people in 2025), cinema and conservation.

name: Museu de Arte Moderna da Bahia
Fundação Bienal de São Paulo
known: The 36th Bienal, curated by Bonaventure Soh Bejeng Ndikung, ran from 6 September 2025 to 11 January 2026 with 125 participants (Times Brasil).
The board is chaired by Eduardo Saron;
Frances Reynolds chairs the International Advisory Board (stated by the space).

name: Instituto Tomie Ohtake
known: Ricardo Ohtake left the presidency in 2023 and joined the advisory council, and Gabriela Moulin became executive director in 2024.

name: MASP
known: Founded by the media owner Assis Chateaubriand of Diários Associados with the Italian critic Pietro Maria Bardi.

name: Museu de Arte Brasileira da FAAP
known: Its first directors were Lucia Comenale and Roberto Pinto de Souza (MAB website).
Current exhibition: "Miró: Mestre das Formas", more than 100 works, organised by the Instituto Totex in partnership with FAAP and MAB, curated by Jordi J.
The Miró exhibition is organised by the Instituto Totex, whose CEO is Roberto Souza Leão (CNN Brasil, 22 July 2026;

name: Museu de Arte Moderna de São Paulo
known: In 1963 the founder moved to dissolve the museum and donate its collection to the University of São Paulo.

name: Pivô
known: Fernanda Brenner is the founder and artistic director (pivo.org.br).
ArtReview (Claire Rigby, 2013) quotes her as co-founder.

name: Sesc São Paulo
known: Luiz Galina is named as Director of Sesc São Paulo (e-flux).

name: Sofia City Art Gallery
known: Programme example: the "Other Eye" project, launched in 2010, in which people who are not art historians curate shows from the permanent collection. "Portrait of a Friend" (2019) was its fifth, curated by the filmmaker Iglika Trifonova (Sofia Globe).
The pages read name no director.
